text: This is Outnumbered. I'm Harris Faulkner. Here with my co-hosts, Emily Campagno and Kaylee McEnany. Also joining us today, Lisa Booth, Fox News political analyst, and Douglas Murray, New York Post columnist and author of his brand new book on democracies and death cults.
